prompt: Above a broken layer of low cloud at night, from the height of a cruising airliner: through the gaps lies a great British city, and beneath the cloud deck a dozen fires light it from below in separate orange pools, so the cloud glows in patches like embers under ash. One fresh blast flashes white inside the cloud and lights a whole bank of it. Above, a clear black sky with a few stars. Wide, 24mm. Documentary night photograph, gritty grain, no flare, no glow added. 16:9, no writing.
